sections.title: What is Posture?
points: Posture is the way a person positions their body while sitting, standing, or walking.
Importance: Helps the skeleton develop properly and allows internal organs to function well.

sections.title: Dental Health
points: Teeth are part of the skeletal system because they are hard and contain Calcium.
Habits: Brush and floss twice a day to remove food and plaque.
Mineral Rule: Calcium and Phosphorus keep teeth strong; Vitamin D is needed to absorb them.

sections.text: Slouching causes poor blood circulation and compresses the chest, making it harder for the lungs to take in oxygen!

cards.fact: A result of bad posture crushing the stomach.
